title: From "google it" to "ask ChatGPT": is AI eating Google's search business?
summary: Google still handles more than five times as many queries as ChatGPT, and search revenue is still growing. But search now earns less than half of Alphabet's income, AI answers earn less than ads next to links, and investors just wiped $500 billion off the stock in a day.

title: Five AI assistants that matter in finance: how they work and where they fit
summary: ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Copilot and Perplexity run on the same transformer foundation, but differ in what is built around it. What that means for finance, automation and different roles.

title: AI on the ballot: why towns are saying no to data centers
summary: Every AI answer runs on a building in someone's town. On Tuesday, 41 towns got to vote on whether they wanted one. Almost all of them said no.

title: When Social Unrest Becomes Financial Risk: France's Sovereign Debt and Investor Confidence
summary: French 10-year yields hit 5%, their highest since 2002, as student protests escalated. Did the protests create the risk, or expose it?

title: Tesla's flying Roadster: an engineering win, a financial non-event
summary: Tesla fell 2.13% the day after the reveal, almost exactly the same as the Nasdaq. Why the event barely moved the price, and what rates, inflation and oil did instead.

title: NVIDIA at $5 trillion: a great company priced for its best case
summary: My reverse DCF shows the price needs about 21% growth a year to 2032. NVIDIA earns over $100bn in economic profit, but my base case values the shares about 28% below the market.
